title: iPhone held by lead, unused for 0 min while 1 job waits

messages.text:
lead has held the iPhone lease for 0 min without a phone run (iphone.mjs run, scroll, record or gesture; since 00:40Z, lease taken by lead). The limit is 5 min.
Waiting on the status board: device-plan (owner mgmt-devices; its note names the phone).
What unblocks it: lead runs its phone part now, or releases the lease (node tools/lock.mjs release iphone --owner lead), or says why it waits.
Steward (mgmt-devices): answer the user here; the lead is the second tier (I-175).
One message per idle period; this thread closes by itself when the phone is used again or released (tools/idle.mjs, I-105, I-111).
